Select IC50 activity records with provenance for tylophorine and its salts against RAW264.7. First, define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL493620 to include all related forms. Then, retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for target CHEMBL612557 (RAW264.7) and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (preferring pubmed_id), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by all output columns.
